stories.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
stories.explanation: OpenAI's GPT-6 models demonstrated intrinsic protein-design capabilities, creating new protein shapes and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests showed evidence of binding across five targets, indicating a significant advance in AI for protein biology.

stories.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
stories.explanation: OpenAI and Cisco introduced Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux, designed to protect running systems during patch rollouts. A controlled test showed it blocked an exploit without requiring a restart, enhancing system security.

stories.title: What's going on with the Riemann hypothesis?
stories.explanation: A mathematician reportedly used AI to help crack the Riemann hypothesis, a major problem in mathematics. This development, following other AI-enabled breakthroughs, has left the field of mathematics in a state of upset as researchers digest the implications.

stories.title: Tidal announces ban on AI-generated music; 27 million tracks will be deleted
stories.explanation: Tidal announced it will ban all AI-generated music and delete 27 million existing AI tracks from its platform starting December 9. This policy shift aims to protect human artists after a significant increase in AI-generated uploads.

stories.title: Supercharging transformer residual connections
stories.explanation: Google Research presented DeepCrossAttention (DCA), an architecture that enhances transformer networks by dynamically combining outputs from previous layers. This allows models to achieve the same quality up to three times faster with a negligible increase in parameters.

stories.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
stories.explanation: Google DeepMind used teams of Gemini 4 agents and formal verification to improve quantum algorithms, creating highly efficient quantum circuits. This could help solve complex scientific challenges like fusion energy and drug design.

stories.title: What’s new in Microsoft Foundry | Ignite 2026
stories.explanation: Microsoft Foundry announced updates at Ignite 2026 for agents, developer tools, and models, including a path from agent trace problems to testable fixes. This aims to improve agent quality and provide more control over model configurations.

stories.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
stories.explanation: A new benchmark called ShellBench reveals that advanced AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta struggle with everyday tasks, failing over a third of the time and often introducing safety issues. This indicates that current AI agents are not yet reliable for complex real-world applications despite marketing efforts.

stories.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
stories.explanation: Anthropic's stock fell below its IPO price, trading as low as $76 a share, down nearly 12% from Monday's close. This post-IPO slump is seen as a worrying sign for AI startup valuations and could impact future IPO prospects in the sector.

stories.title: Anthropic Created a Honeypot to Lure AI Agents Into Misbehaving
stories.explanation: Anthropic researchers developed Siren, a new 'honeypot' test that places AI agents in simulated environments to tempt them into misbehaving. This test helps evaluate the likelihood of AI models going rogue and the effectiveness of safety measures.
